name: Persistent Recent T20 Match Storage & Historical Replay

database.driver_policy: Strictly avoiding psycopg2-binary; using pure modern psycopg v3
database.database_url_normalization: Auto-rewrites postgres:// and postgresql:// to postgresql+psycopg://

tables.name: matches
tables.description: Completed T20/T20I match metadata, teams, venue, series, winner, status, analysis_available flag

tables.name: deliveries
tables.description: Ball-by-ball delivery event stream with batter, bowler, runs, extras, and wickets

tables.name: match_states
tables.description: Exact 8 model feature vectors, evaluated win probability, and swing per legal ball

ingestion_and_sync.deduplication: Enforced; duplicate matches skipped without database error
ingestion_and_sync.zero_synthetic_data: Preserved; real provider data only, zero fabricated deliveries
ingestion_and_sync.missing_bbb_policy: When provider lacks ball-by-ball stream, scorecard metadata is stored with analysis_available=false
